comment: Expected output shape, derived from the LISTING'S CLAIMS (actor description + README field table + dataset schema). Structural fields (publicationNumber, sourceUrl, publicationDate) are produced for every delivered record by construction — records without a usable publication guid are dropped at parse time and records without a publication date are never delivered — so their claim floor is 100%. Content fields carry the floor the listing promises. Breach = observed rate outside [min - margin, max + margin]. Floors to be confirmed against the staging census before publish (claims-vs-data gate); the census never RAISES a floor above what the listing claims.

applicationNumber.basis: Claimed on at least 95% of records in the README field table. Workspace census 2026-11-21: 200/200 on a Nov 2026 sample.

assignee.basis: Claimed on at least 90% of records in the README field table (the recorded assignee, or the applicant where no assignee is recorded). Workspace census 2026-11-21: applicantName present on 100/100 sampled records, so the fallback keeps this near-total.

cpcCodes.basis: Claimed on at least 85% of records in the README field table (the inventive CPC classifications as indexed). Workspace census 2026-11-21: 100/100 on a Nov 2026 sample; the floor leaves room for document types the index classifies late.

familyId.basis: Claimed on at least 95% of records in the README field table (USPTO's current family identifier). Workspace census 2026-11-21: 200/200.

filingDate.basis: Claimed on at least 95% of records in the README field table. Workspace census 2026-11-21: 100/100 on a Nov 2026 sample.

inventors.basis: Claimed on at least 90% of records in the README field table (the first-listed inventor; the search payload names no others). Workspace census 2026-11-21: inventorsShort present on 100/100 sampled records.

kindCode.basis: Claimed on at least 95% of records in the README field table (the kind code from the publication guid / payload, agreeing 200/200 in the workspace census 2026-11-21).

patentTitle.basis: Claimed per record in the listing description and README (the patent title as indexed). Workspace census 2026-11-21: 100/100.

priorityDate.basis: Present only where the publication claims priority — first filings have none. Workspace census 2026-11-21: 2/200 on the freshest Nov 2026 applications (priority claims arrive with older/grant corpora). The listing claims the field qualitatively; this floor sits near the fresh-corpus minimum and guards against total disappearance.

publicationDate.basis: Structural: records without a usable publication date are skipped, never delivered.

publicationNumber.basis: Structural: results without a usable publication guid are dropped at parse time and never delivered.

sourceUrl.basis: Constructed per record from the publication number (the official USPTO PDF link).

type.basis: Derived per record from the source database (USPAT = grant, US-PGPUB = application), with the kind code as fallback — set by construction on every delivered record.
